meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Money stock, its components and sources, every reporting fortnight since 2001, as the Weekly Statistical Supplement prints it (also report 770)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 13 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 2 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2017-03-31) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right.
